generic.Test population: All schedule rating categories, deviation tolerances and decision rules in the guidance.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any tolerance in the guidance exceeds the filed rule maximum.
generic.Exception handling path: Requests to exceed a filed range route to the Pricing Actuary and require a rate rule refiling.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Schedule ranges, deviation tolerances by authority level and documentation requirements stated.
generic.Evidence location: Pricing guidance section in SharePoint and the rate rules held in Earnix Rating and Pricing.

steps.title: Document the schedule rating credit and debit categories
sop: List each schedule rating category the product will use.
State the maximum credit and maximum debit swing permitted in each category.
Record the overall maximum schedule modification across all categories.
Done when every category shows its maximum credit and debit.
verify: Sum the category maxima and compare to the overall maximum stated.
Pass when the category maxima are consistent with the overall cap.

steps.title: State deviation tolerance by underwriting authority level
sop: State the maximum pricing deviation from filed rates for each authority level.
Keep the tolerances rising monotonically with authority level.
Record the tolerances in the pricing guidance table.
Done when every authority level has a stated deviation tolerance.
verify: Read the tolerance table from the lowest authority level upward.
Pass when every level has a tolerance and the sequence is monotonic.

steps.title: Write the accept, refer and decline decision rules
sop: Write the underwriting decision rules as accept, refer or decline outcomes.
Tie each rule to specific risk attributes rather than general guidance.
Check the refer outcomes route to the authority level in the matrix.
Done when every decision rule states an outcome tied to risk attributes.
verify: Apply a sample risk to each rule and record the outcome produced.
Pass when each rule returns exactly one of accept, refer or decline.

steps.title: Specify the file documentation required for deviations
sop: State the file documentation required to support any credit, debit or deviation applied.
Name the evidence type required for each schedule rating category.
Record the documentation requirement against each category and tolerance.
Done when every credit, debit and deviation names its documentation requirement.
verify: Filter the guidance table for rows with no documentation requirement.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Reconcile the ranges to the filed rate rules
sop: Retrieve the filed rate rule maxima from Earnix Rating and Pricing.
Compare every schedule range and deviation tolerance in the guidance to the filed maxima.
Reduce any guidance value that exceeds a filed maximum and record the change.
Done when no guidance value exceeds its filed rule maximum.
verify: Re-run the comparison against the filed rule maxima.
Pass when every guidance range sits within the filed maximum.

steps.title: Version and file the pricing guidance section
sop: Increment the pricing guidance version and cite the filed rate rule version.
File the section into the underwriting guidelines draft in SharePoint.
Notify the guidelines owner and the Insurance Product Dev Lead.
Done when the versioned section is filed and notified.
verify: Open the guidelines draft and locate the pricing guidance section.
Pass when the section is present and cites the filed rule version.

generic.Defined scope/population: The underwriting guidelines document and the review cadence and triggers that govern it.
generic.In-scope period: The review cycle running from the approval date to the next scheduled review date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cadence, next review date, reviewer group, approver and event triggers are all recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Diarised review dates in the governance calendar match the cadence on the document control page.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approved review-cycle schedule dated on the guidelines document control page in SharePoint.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missed or deferred reviews logged with the reason and the rescheduled date.
generic.Test population: The review cadence, the event trigger list and the diarised calendar entries.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any review interval exceeds the approved maximum cadence or a review date is undiarised.
generic.Exception handling path: Off-cycle triggers route to the guidelines owner to convene an unscheduled review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Next review date diarised with the reviewer group and approver named and triggers documented.
generic.Evidence location: Guidelines document control page and the governance calendar in SharePoint.

steps.title: Set the standing review cadence
sop: Agree the standing review cadence for the underwriting guidelines.
Check the cadence does not exceed the approved maximum interval.
Record the cadence on the guidelines document control page.
Done when the cadence is recorded and within the approved maximum.
verify: Compare the recorded cadence against the approved maximum interval.
Pass when the cadence is equal to or shorter than the maximum.

steps.title: Define the off-cycle event triggers
sop: List the events that force an off-cycle review of the guidelines.
Include rate or form refiling, regulatory change, adverse loss emergence and appetite change.
Record each trigger with the party responsible for raising it.
Done when every mandated trigger is documented with a responsible party.
verify: Check the trigger list against the four mandated events.
Pass when all four appear with a responsible party.

steps.title: Name the reviewer group and the approver
sop: Name the roles required at each guidelines review.
Name the approver of the review outcome.
Record both on the document control page.
Done when the reviewer group and approver are named on the control page.
verify: Read the control page for the reviewer group and approver entries.
Pass when both are named.

steps.title: Diarise the review dates in the governance calendar
sop: Calculate the review dates from the approval date using the agreed cadence.
Enter each date in the SharePoint governance calendar.
Set reminders to the guidelines owner ahead of each date.
Done when every review date is diarised with a reminder set.
verify: Open the governance calendar and check the entries against the cadence.
Pass when the next review date is diarised with a reminder.

steps.title: Record the schedule on the document control page
sop: Record the approved review-cycle schedule on the guidelines document control page.
Include the cadence, next review date, triggers, reviewer group and approver.
Version and date the control page.
Done when the control page carries the complete approved schedule.
verify: Read the control page for all five schedule elements.
Pass when every element is present and dated.

steps.title: Obtain approval of the review-cycle schedule
sop: Submit the review-cycle schedule to the named approver.
Record the approval with the approver name and date.
File the approval with the guidelines document control page.
Done when the schedule approval is recorded and filed.
verify: Open the filed approval and check the approver and date.
Pass when the schedule shows a dated approval.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every underwriting grade and its limits by premium, policy limit, line and hazard class.
generic.In-scope period: The authority matrix version handed to policy system configuration.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each grade row records premium limit, policy limit, line, hazard class and referral target.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Matrix grade count matches the underwriting grades in the organisation structure.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Versioned authority matrix dated in SharePoint and referenced in the configuration handover.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Authority values above treaty retention or CUO delegation logged and reduced before issue.
generic.Test population: All authority levels and thresholds in the matrix and their configured equivalents.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any configured authority level exceeds the approved matrix ceiling.
generic.Exception handling path: Requests above matrix ceiling route to the Insurance Product Dev Lead and require CUO approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Numeric authority limits by premium, limit, line and hazard class for every underwriting grade.
generic.Evidence location: Authority matrix in SharePoint and the referral rule configuration in the policy system.

steps.title: Build the authority matrix by underwriting grade
sop: Create one row per underwriting grade in the matrix held in SharePoint.
Enter the premium limit, policy limit, line of business and hazard class limits for each grade.
Use numeric values throughout rather than descriptive authority statements.
Done when every grade row carries all four numeric limits.
verify: Filter the matrix for rows missing any of the four limits.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Define the referral escalation thresholds
sop: Define the threshold at which a risk must escalate from each grade to the next.
Name the authority level the referral escalates to.
Check no threshold leaves a gap between adjacent grades.
Done when every grade has an escalation threshold and a named target level.
verify: Walk the thresholds from the lowest grade to the highest.
Pass when the thresholds are continuous with a named target at each step.

steps.title: Separate pricing authority from binding authority
sop: State the pricing deviation and schedule rating authority for each grade separately.
Keep these values distinct from the binding authority limits in the matrix.
Cross-check the pricing authority against the pricing guidance tolerances.
Done when pricing and binding authority are stated as separate values per grade.
verify: Compare the pricing authority column against the pricing guidance tolerances.
Pass when the two are consistent and separately stated.

steps.title: Check the matrix against treaty retention and CUO delegation
sop: Retrieve the treaty retention figures and the CUO delegated authority limit.
Compare every authority level in the matrix against both ceilings.
Reduce any level that exceeds either ceiling and record the change.
Done when no authority level exceeds the treaty retention or CUO delegation.
verify: Re-run the comparison against both ceilings.
Pass when every matrix value sits at or below both ceilings.

steps.title: Hand the matrix to configuration in the required field structure
sop: Reformat the approved matrix into the field structure the policy system referral rules require.
Hand the structured file to configuration with the matrix version referenced.
Record the handover date and the version supplied.
Done when the structured matrix is handed over and the handover is recorded.
verify: Open the handover record and the supplied file.
Pass when the file matches the required structure and cites the approved version.

steps.title: Confirm the configured limits match the approved matrix
sop: Extract the configured authority limits from the policy administration system.
Compare each configured value against the approved matrix value.
Raise a defect for any configured value above the matrix ceiling.
Done when every configured authority value matches the approved matrix.
verify: Run the comparison of configured values against the matrix.
Pass when no configured authority level exceeds the approved ceiling.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every peer-review comment raised on the reviewed underwriting guidelines draft.
generic.In-scope period: The review round covering the guidelines version being revised.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each comment records disposition, applied edit reference and rationale where rejected.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Closed comment count equals the comments logged in the peer review round.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Incremented guidelines version with redline and change summary dated in SharePoint.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected comments logged with rationale and notified back to the reviewer who raised them.
generic.Test population: All comments in the guidelines peer review log.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any comment remains open or the revision has no redline against the reviewed version.
generic.Exception handling path: Disputed rejections escalate to the Insurance Product Dev Lead before the version is issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No open review comment and an incremented version with redline and change summary.
generic.Evidence location: Peer review log, redline and change summary in the SharePoint guidelines folder.

steps.title: Apply each accepted comment to the guidelines draft
sop: Work the peer review log and apply each accepted comment to the draft.
Record the section and clause edited against the comment row.
Mark the comment closed once the edit is applied.
Done when every accepted comment is applied and marked closed.
verify: Sample accepted comments and locate the corresponding edit in the draft.
Pass when each sampled comment has a matching applied edit.

steps.title: Record rationale for rejected comments and notify reviewers
sop: Write a rationale against every rejected comment in the log.
Notify the reviewer who raised each rejected comment.
Record the notification date against the comment row.
Done when every rejected comment has a rationale and a notification date.
verify: Filter rejected rows for missing rationale or notification date.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Re-check the authority matrix and referral triggers after edits
sop: Re-read the authority matrix and referral triggers after the edits are applied.
Check the thresholds remain internally consistent and continuous.
Correct any threshold broken by an applied edit.
Done when the matrix and triggers are consistent after the edits.
verify: Walk the thresholds from the lowest grade upward in the revised draft.
Pass when no gap or contradiction remains between thresholds.

steps.title: Check Compliance-affecting edits with the Compliance Analyst
sop: Review edits touching eligibility, declination or state-restricted content.
Confirm the revised wording remains compliant in every target state.
Record the Compliance confirmation against the revision.
Done when all compliance-affecting edits carry a recorded confirmation.
verify: List the compliance-affecting edits and check for confirmations.
Pass when every such edit carries a Compliance confirmation.

steps.title: Produce the redline against the reviewed version
sop: Generate a redline of the revised guidelines against the reviewed version.
Check the redline shows every applied edit and no unintended change.
Save the redline in the SharePoint guidelines folder.
Done when the redline is produced and saved against the revision.
verify: Open the redline and compare its changes to the closed comment list.
Pass when every closed accepted comment appears as a redline change.

steps.title: Issue the incremented version with a change summary
sop: Increment the guidelines version number on the document control page.
Write the change summary listing each applied change.
Issue the revision to the approver and the reviewer group.
Done when the incremented version is issued with its change summary.
verify: Open the issued version and check the version number and change summary.
Pass when both are present and the redline is attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every risk characteristic collected and every rate factor in the rating plan.
generic.In-scope period: The rating plan version current at the time the mapping table is issued.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each row records characteristic, coverage terms affected, rate factor, data type and permitted values.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rate factors in the mapping table reconcile one for one with the rating plan factor list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Versioned mapping table dated in SharePoint with the pricing confirmation attached.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Characteristics driving neither coverage nor rating logged and justified or dropped.
generic.Test population: All risk characteristics in the mapping table and all factors in the rating plan.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a rate factor has no source characteristic or a row lacks data type and permitted values.
generic.Exception handling path: Unmatched factors route to the Product / Filing Actuary for resolution before issue.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: One row per characteristic with coverage terms, rate factor, data type and permitted values.
generic.Evidence location: Mapping table in SharePoint and the factor list in Earnix Rating and Pricing.

steps.title: Build the mapping table row per risk characteristic
sop: Create one row per risk characteristic collected on the application.
Record the coverage terms each characteristic affects on its row.
Record the rate factor each characteristic drives on the same row.
Done when every collected characteristic has a row with coverage terms and rate factor.
verify: Compare the row count against the collected characteristic list.
Pass when every collected characteristic has a mapping row.

steps.title: Flag characteristics that drive neither coverage nor rating
sop: Filter for characteristics with no coverage term and no rate factor.
Justify each with an operational or regulatory reason or propose dropping it.
Record the decision against the characteristic row.
Done when every unused characteristic is justified or marked for removal.
verify: Filter for unused characteristics with no recorded decision.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Resolve rate factors with no source characteristic
sop: List every rate factor in the Earnix rating plan.
Match each factor to a source characteristic in the mapping table.
Raise a question or add a characteristic where no source exists.
Done when every rate factor names a source characteristic.
verify: Compare the rating plan factor list against the mapped factors.
Pass when no rate factor is left without a mapped source characteristic.

steps.title: Record data type, permitted values and default per characteristic
sop: Record the data type for each characteristic so it can be configured.
List the permitted values or the numeric range for each characteristic.
State the default value where one applies.
Done when every characteristic row shows data type and permitted values.
verify: Filter the mapping table for rows missing data type or permitted values.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Obtain pricing confirmation of the mapping
sop: Review the mapping table against the rating algorithm.
Confirm each mapped factor is applied as the algorithm expects.
Record the confirmation with name and date on the mapping table.
Done when pricing has confirmed the mapping matches the algorithm.
verify: Open the mapping table and read the pricing confirmation block.
Pass when a dated pricing confirmation is recorded.

steps.title: Version and issue the mapping table
sop: Increment the mapping table version and date it.
Issue it to configuration, underwriting and the actuarial team.
File it in the SharePoint product design library.
Done when the versioned mapping table is issued and filed.
verify: Open the library record for the issued mapping table.
Pass when the current version is filed and its recipients recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: The final underwriting guidelines version and its attached authority matrix.
generic.In-scope period: The guidelines version submitted for Chief Underwriting Officer approval.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approval names the guidelines version number, effective date and the approving officer.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The authority matrix in the guidelines matches the matrix version loaded to the policy system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Executed CUO approval filed dated in the product governance record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Conditions attached to the approval logged as actions with owners and due dates.
generic.Test population: The submitted guidelines version and its peer-review and Compliance item logs.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a peer-review or Compliance item is open at the point of approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Open items hold the approval and route back to the Insurance Product Dev Lead.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Executed CUO approval citing the guidelines version number and effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Executed approval in the SharePoint product governance record.

steps.title: Confirm the peer-review log is closed
sop: Open the guidelines peer-review log and filter for open comments.
Chase any open comment to closure before submission.
Record the log as closed with the date.
Done when the peer-review log shows zero open comments.
verify: Re-filter the peer-review log for open comments.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Confirm Compliance items are closed
sop: Review the Compliance item list raised against the guidelines.
Confirm each item has been applied or formally withdrawn.
Record the Compliance clearance with the date.
Done when no Compliance item remains open on the guidelines version.
verify: Filter the Compliance item list for open items.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Submit the guidelines and authority matrix for approval
sop: Attach the authority matrix to the final guidelines submission.
State the version number and proposed effective date in the submission.
Send to the Chief Underwriting Officer and record the submission date.
Done when the submission is sent with the matrix attached and recorded.
verify: Open the submission record and check the attachments and version stated.
Pass when the matrix is attached and the version and effective date are stated.

steps.title: Obtain the CUO signature naming version and effective date
sop: Obtain the Chief Underwriting Officer signature on the approval sheet.
Confirm the sheet names the guidelines version number and effective date.
Return the sheet for correction if either is absent.
Done when a signed sheet naming version and effective date is held.
verify: Read the signed sheet for the version number and effective date.
Pass when both are present and match the submitted version.

steps.title: Log approval conditions as tracked actions
sop: Record each condition attached to the approval as an action.
Assign an owner and due date to each action in the governance log.
Notify each owner of the condition.
Done when every condition exists as an owned, dated action.
verify: Compare the stated conditions against the governance action log.
Pass when every condition has a matching owned action.

steps.title: Confirm the approved matrix matches the system load
sop: Compare the approved authority matrix against the version being loaded to the policy system.
Raise a hold where the two differ and resolve before the load proceeds.
Record the confirmation against the approval entry.
Done when the approved matrix and the system load version match.
verify: Run a value comparison between the approved matrix and the load file.
Pass when the two match on every authority value.

steps.title: File the executed approval in the governance record
sop: File the executed approval in the product governance record.
Link it to the approved guidelines version in the repository.
Apply the governance retention class.
Done when the executed approval is filed and linked to the version.
verify: Open the guidelines version record and follow the approval link.
Pass when the executed approval opens from the version record.

generic.Defined scope/population: The approved underwriting guidelines and every underwriter audience in the affected lines.
generic.In-scope period: The guidelines version effective from the CUO-approved effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Publication tagged with product code, version, effective date and CUO approval reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Published guideline sections match the approved document contents page.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Knowledge base and training library entries carry the version and publication date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Access failures found in the sample check logged and resolved before the notice is sent.
generic.Test population: The published guidelines entry and an underwriter access sample from each affected line.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a superseded version is still shown as current or a sampled user cannot open it.
generic.Exception handling path: Publication defects route to the Product Development Analyst before notification.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approved guidelines published and tagged with product code, version and effective date.
generic.Evidence location: Knowledge base publication record and training library entry in the document repository.

steps.title: Publish the approved guidelines to the knowledge base
sop: Upload the CUO-approved guidelines to the underwriting knowledge base.
Add the same version to the training library.
Confirm both copies open and are the approved version.
Done when the approved guidelines are live in both locations.
verify: Open both entries and compare against the approved version.
Pass when both hold the approved version.

steps.title: Tag the publication with product, version and approval data
sop: Apply product code, version and effective date tags to the publication.
Add the CUO approval reference to the metadata.
Save and confirm the metadata displays on the entry.
Done when all four metadata fields are populated.
verify: Read the metadata fields on the published entry.
Pass when product code, version, effective date and approval reference are populated.

steps.title: Mark prior guideline versions superseded
sop: List every prior guidelines version in the knowledge base.
Mark each superseded and remove it from the current-document view.
Confirm the current view returns only the approved version.
Done when no prior version is returned as current.
verify: Query the current-document view for the guidelines.
Pass when only the approved version is returned.

steps.title: Sample-test underwriter access in each affected line
sop: Select a sample underwriter in each affected line of business.
Ask each to open the published guidelines using their own access.
Log any access failure and have permissions corrected.
Done when a sampled underwriter in every affected line can open the guidelines.
verify: Review the access test results by line.
Pass when every affected line reports a successful access test.

steps.title: Send the publication notice to the distribution lists
sop: Send the publication notice to underwriting, operations and training distribution lists.
State the version, effective date and knowledge base link in the notice.
Record the send date and recipient lists.
Done when the notice is sent to all three lists and recorded.
verify: Check the notice record for the three distribution lists.
Pass when all three were included and the send date is recorded.

steps.title: Record the publication in the governance record
sop: Record the publication date, version and locations in the governance record.
Link the entry to the CUO approval.
Note the access test outcome on the entry.
Done when the publication entry is complete and linked to the approval.
verify: Open the governance publication entry.
Pass when it names version, date, locations and the approval link.

generic.Defined scope/population: The historical policy book selected for back-testing the draft guidelines rules.
generic.In-scope period: The agreed back-test experience period stated in the method note.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each historical risk records the applied decision, premium, loss and resulting tier.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Policy counts and premium in the back-test reconcile to the policy administration system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Back-test output and method note stored in SharePoint with the run date and data extract date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Profitable business the rules would have excluded logged and the rule flagged for reconsideration.
generic.Test population: All historical risks in the back-test period after the reconciliation is signed.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the back-test is presented without a data reconciliation to the source system.
generic.Exception handling path: Reconciliation variances route to the Pricing Actuary before results are published.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Decision outcome and loss ratio impact per historical cohort with method and period documented.
generic.Evidence location: Actuarial modelling platform back-test output and method note in SharePoint.

steps.title: Assemble the historical book for the back-test period
sop: Extract the historical policy and loss data for the agreed back-test period.
Record the extract criteria and the extract run date in the method note.
Load the extract into the actuarial modelling platform.
Done when the back-test dataset is loaded with its extract criteria recorded.
verify: Read the method note for the period, criteria and extract date.
Pass when all three are recorded against the loaded dataset.

steps.title: Reconcile counts and premium to the source system
sop: Compare policy counts and written premium in the extract to the policy system totals.
Investigate and explain any variance beyond the agreed tolerance.
Sign the reconciliation and attach it to the method note.
Done when a signed reconciliation to the source system is attached.
verify: Read the signed reconciliation for counts, premium and variance explanation.
Pass when the reconciliation is signed and variances are explained.

steps.title: Apply the draft rules to each historical risk
sop: Apply the draft eligibility, declination and tier rules to every historical risk.
Record the resulting decision and tier against each policy record.
Check that every record received a decision.
Done when every historical risk carries a rule-based decision and tier.
verify: Filter the dataset for records with no decision or tier.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Quantify the premium, loss and loss ratio impact
sop: Total the premium and loss that would have been declined or re-tiered.
Calculate the resulting change in loss ratio versus the actual book.
Present the impact by cohort as well as in total.
Done when the loss ratio impact is quantified by cohort and in total.
verify: Check the cohort impacts sum to the total impact.
Pass when the cohort and total figures reconcile.

steps.title: Flag rules that would have excluded profitable business
sop: Identify declined or re-tiered business that was profitable in the actual book.
Trace each case back to the specific draft rule that excluded it.
Flag those rules for reconsideration in the guidelines review.
Done when every rule excluding profitable business is flagged with its evidence.
verify: Check the flagged rule list against the profitable exclusion cases.
Pass when every such case names the rule that caused it.

steps.title: Document the method and route the results to review
sop: Document the back-test method, period, data source and results in the method note.
Attach the reconciliation and cohort impact tables.
Route the documented results to the guidelines review.
Done when the documented back-test is routed to the guidelines review.
verify: Open the method note and check for method, period, source and results.
Pass when all four are documented and the routing is recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every rating variable, its levels and relativities in the classification plan.
generic.In-scope period: The experience and relativity basis current at the time the plan is peer reviewed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each variable records its levels, relativity values and its place in the calculation order.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Benchmark premiums from the plan reconcile to independent hand calculations.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Versioned classification plan and algorithm stored in Earnix with the peer review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Variables restricted in a target state logged and removed or state-limited before filing.
generic.Test population: All rating variables and at least three benchmark risks spanning the plan.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a benchmark premium differs from the hand calculation or a variable is state-prohibited.
generic.Exception handling path: Permissibility questions route to the Product Development Analyst for a state-limit decision before filing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Ordered rating algorithm with every variable, level and relativity documented and peer reviewed.
generic.Evidence location: Classification plan and algorithm documentation in Earnix Rating and Pricing.

steps.title: Build the classification plan variable and level list
sop: List every rating variable the plan will use in Earnix Rating and Pricing.
List the levels of each variable and the relativity attached to each level.
Record the source of each relativity selection.
Done when every variable shows its levels, relativities and source.
verify: Filter the plan for variables with missing levels or relativities.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Document the rating algorithm as an ordered calculation
sop: Write the algorithm as an ordered sequence of calculation steps.
Show where each factor, cap, rounding and minimum premium applies.
Store the algorithm document with the classification plan.
Done when the algorithm is documented as an ordered calculation.
verify: Follow the algorithm from base rate to final premium.
Pass when each factor and cap has an unambiguous position in the order.

steps.title: Screen variables for permissibility in target states
sop: Compare each classification variable against the restricted rating factor list per target state.
Flag variables that are prohibited or restricted in any target state.
Remove or state-limit each flagged variable and record the decision.
Done when every variable is permissible or state-limited with a recorded decision.
verify: Re-run the permissibility screen for every target state.
Pass when no classification variable is restricted in a target filing state.

steps.title: Reproduce benchmark premiums by hand calculation
sop: Select at least three benchmark risks spanning the plan variables.
Calculate the premium for each by hand from the documented algorithm.
Compare the hand calculation against the plan output in Earnix.
Done when all three benchmarks have been calculated and compared.
verify: Compare the hand and plan premiums for each benchmark.
Pass when every benchmark reconciles within the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Route the plan for actuarial peer review
sop: Send the classification plan and algorithm for actuarial peer review.
Log each peer review finding with the variable or step it affects.
Close every finding before the plan enters the filing package.
Done when the peer review is complete with all findings closed.
verify: Filter the peer review log for open findings.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Version and release the classification plan
sop: Increment the classification plan version and date it.
Release it to the filing package owner and to configuration.
Record the release in the actuarial modelling platform documentation set.
Done when the versioned plan is released and recorded.
verify: Open the release record and check the version and recipients.
Pass when the released version matches the peer-reviewed plan.

generic.Defined scope/population: Fixed and variable expense, profit and contingency loadings for the product rate.
generic.In-scope period: The expense study period and the statutory financial year used for reconciliation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each loading records its value, derivation basis, allocation basis and supporting approval.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Expense provision reconciles to general and acquisition expense in the statutory financials.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Loading exhibits stored in the actuarial modelling platform with the study version and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Loadings without a documented source logged and either sourced or removed before issue.
generic.Test population: All loading components carried into the rate calculation.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any loading component lacks a documented source or approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Margin selections outside the approved range route to the Product / Filing Actuary for approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Fixed and variable expense, profit and contingency provisions with derivation and allocation basis.
generic.Evidence location: Loading exhibits in the actuarial modelling platform and the expense study in Earnix.

steps.title: Derive fixed and variable expense loadings from the expense study
sop: Take the fixed and variable expense figures from the current expense study.
Derive the loading for each and state the allocation basis used.
Record the derivation in the actuarial modelling platform workbook.
Done when both expense loadings are derived with a stated allocation basis.
verify: Read the derivation for the allocation basis and the source figures.
Pass when both loadings trace to the expense study.

steps.title: Set the profit and contingency provision
sop: Select the underwriting profit and contingency provision for the product.
Record the approval that supports the selected margin.
Note any deviation from the standard company margin and its reason.
Done when the provision is set with its supporting approval recorded.
verify: Read the provision entry for the value and the approval reference.
Pass when both are present.

steps.title: Reconcile the expense provision to the statutory financials
sop: Compare the expense provision to general expense and acquisition expense in the statutory financials.
Explain any difference between the provision and the reported expense ratio.
Record the reconciliation with the financial year referenced.
Done when the expense provision reconciles to the statutory financials.
verify: Read the reconciliation for the comparison and explanation.
Pass when the provision ties to the statutory expense with variances explained.

steps.title: Show the implied permissible loss ratio
sop: Calculate the permissible loss ratio implied by the selected loadings.
Compare it to the pricing target loss ratio for the product.
Record the comparison and explain any difference.
Done when the implied permissible loss ratio is calculated and compared to target.
verify: Recalculate the permissible loss ratio from the loading set.
Pass when the implied ratio matches the pricing target within tolerance.

steps.title: Source-check every loading component
sop: List every loading component carried into the rate.
Confirm each names a documented source or approval.
Return components without a source for sourcing or removal.
Done when every loading component names a source or approval.
verify: Filter the loading list for components with no source or approval.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Format the loadings into the filing exhibit set
sop: Lay out each loading in the exhibit format the rate filing will use.
Number the exhibits so the memorandum can cite them.
Store the exhibits with the rate development documentation.
Done when every loading appears in a numbered filing exhibit.
verify: Check the exhibit set against the loading list.
Pass when every loading component appears in a numbered exhibit.

generic.Defined scope/population: The illustration set for the product and the sampled illustrated values recalculated.
generic.In-scope period: The currently filed rates, charges and guaranteed elements at the certification date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Certification names the illustration version, date, basis certified and the certifying actuary.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Independent recalculations reconcile to the illustration output for every sampled profile.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed certification filed with the illustration set version and date in the product record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Recalculation differences logged and resolved before the certification is signed.
generic.Test population: The sampled illustrated values and the non-guaranteed element labelling across the set.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any illustration circulates without a signed dated certification.
generic.Exception handling path: Unsupportable non-guaranteed elements route to the Product / Filing Actuary for withdrawal.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Independent recalculation reconciling to the illustration output for the sampled profiles.
generic.Evidence location: Signed certification and recalculation workings in the document management repository.

steps.title: Select the illustration sample for recalculation
sop: Select illustrated profiles spanning the tiers, limits and deductibles in the set.
Record the sample selection basis in the certification working paper.
Retrieve the illustration output for each sampled profile.
Done when the sample is selected and its basis recorded.
verify: Read the sample basis against the illustration set contents.
Pass when the sample spans the tiers, limits and deductibles offered.

steps.title: Recalculate the sampled illustrated values independently
sop: Recalculate each sampled illustrated value independently of the illustration engine.
Compare the recalculation to the illustration output value by value.
Log and resolve every difference found.
Done when every sampled value has been recalculated and compared.
verify: Read the comparison table for unresolved differences.
Pass when every sampled value reconciles to the recalculation.

steps.title: Confirm only currently filed elements are used
sop: Compare the rates, charges and guaranteed elements used to the currently filed versions.
Flag any element drawn from an unfiled or superseded version.
Have the illustration regenerated where a flag is raised.
Done when every element used is the currently filed version.
verify: Check the element versions against the filed rate and charge records.
Pass when no unfiled or superseded element remains in the illustration.

steps.title: Verify non-guaranteed element labelling and support
sop: Check every non-guaranteed element is clearly labelled as such on the illustration.
Confirm each is supportable on the current experience basis.
Record the check outcome per illustration.
Done when every non-guaranteed element is labelled and supportable.
verify: Read a sample of illustrations for non-guaranteed labelling.
Pass when every non-guaranteed element is labelled and supported.

steps.title: Sign the actuarial certification
sop: Draft the certification naming the illustration version, date and the basis certified.
Confirm all recalculation differences are resolved before signing.
Sign and date the certification.
Done when a signed certification naming version, date and basis is held.
verify: Read the certification for version, date, basis and signature.
Pass when all four are present.

steps.title: File the certification with the illustration set
sop: File the signed certification with the illustration set in the product record.
Link the certification to the exact illustration version certified.
Confirm no uncertified illustration remains in circulation.
Done when the certification is filed and linked to the illustration version.
verify: List the circulating illustrations and check each for a certification link.
Pass when no illustration is in circulation without a signed certification.

generic.Defined scope/population: The rate level indication for the product covering premium, losses and expense provision.
generic.In-scope period: The stated experience period with on-level factors applied to the current rate level.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: The indication records experience period, on-level factors, trend and development selections.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Earned premium at current rate level reconciles to the on-level exhibit totals.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Indication workbook and exhibit set stored with run date and version in the modelling platform.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Differences between indicated and proposed rate change logged with a written explanation.
generic.Test population: All exhibits supporting the indication and the alternative selection sensitivity runs.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any gap between indicated and proposed change lacks a written explanation.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained indication movements route to the Pricing Actuary before the exhibits are issued.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Indicated versus proposed change with on-level, trend and development selections documented.
generic.Evidence location: Indication workbook and numbered exhibit set in the actuarial modelling platform.

steps.title: Build the rate level indication
sop: Assemble earned premium at current rate level, developed and trended losses and the expense provision.
Calculate the indicated rate level change from those components.
Store the indication workbook in the actuarial modelling platform.
Done when the indication is calculated from all four components.
verify: Recalculate the indication from the stated components.
Pass when the recalculated indication matches the workbook.

steps.title: State the experience period and on-level factors
sop: State the experience period used in the indication.
Record the on-level factors applied and how they were derived.
Record the trend selections and their basis.
Done when period, on-level factors and trend selections are all recorded.
verify: Read the workbook header for period, on-level and trend entries.
Pass when all three are documented with a basis.

steps.title: Compare the indicated change to the proposed change
sop: Compare the indicated rate change to the proposed rate change.
Quantify the difference in percentage points.
Write the explanation for the difference.
Done when the difference is quantified and explained in writing.
verify: Read the comparison and the written explanation.
Pass when no gap between indicated and proposed is left unexplained.

steps.title: Test sensitivity to alternative trend and development selections
sop: Re-run the indication under alternative trend and loss development selections.
Record the indicated change under each alternative.
Comment on how sensitive the indication is to the selections.
Done when the sensitivity runs and commentary are recorded.
verify: Read the sensitivity table for alternative selections and outcomes.
Pass when at least one alternative trend and one alternative development run are shown.

steps.title: Reconcile premium at current rate level to source
sop: Reconcile earned premium at current rate level to the on-level exhibit and the source data.
Explain any variance beyond the agreed tolerance.
Record the reconciliation with the exhibit reference.
Done when the on-level premium reconciles to the source with variances explained.
verify: Compare the on-level exhibit total to the source premium total.
Pass when the totals reconcile within tolerance.

steps.title: Format the indication into the filing exhibit set
sop: Lay out the indication components as numbered filing exhibits in Earnix and the modelling platform.
Check each figure in the indication traces to an exhibit.
Store the exhibit set with the indication version and date.
Done when the indication is formatted as a numbered exhibit set.
verify: Trace a sample of indication figures to their exhibits.
Pass when every sampled figure traces to a numbered exhibit.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every approved rate table and rating rule handed to policy system configuration.
generic.In-scope period: The rate plan version and effective date being configured for the release.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each loaded table carries the rate plan version, effective date and load format fields.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Engine-calculated benchmark premiums reconcile to the actuarial calculations within tolerance.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Configuration change record naming the rate plan version with the load date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Benchmark variances beyond tolerance logged with root cause and fix before sign-off.
generic.Test population: The benchmark risk set covering the rating algorithm order of operations.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an engine premium differs from the actuarial calculation beyond the agreed tolerance.
generic.Exception handling path: Later rate table changes trigger the agreed retest of the benchmark comparison.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Loaded rate tables carry the approved plan version and reproduce the benchmark premiums.
generic.Evidence location: Earnix load record and the change record in the policy administration system.

steps.title: Hand the approved rate tables to configuration
sop: Export the approved rate tables from Earnix in the agreed load format.
Stamp every table with the rate plan version and effective date.
Hand the export to the configuration team with the handover record.
Done when every approved table is handed over stamped with version and effective date.
verify: Open the handover export and read the version and effective date fields.
Pass when every table carries both fields.

steps.title: Walk the algorithm order of operations with configuration
sop: Walk the configuration team through the algorithm order of operations.
Cover rounding, caps and minimum premium treatment explicitly.
Record the walkthrough and any interpretation agreed.
Done when the walkthrough is complete and recorded.
verify: Read the walkthrough record for rounding, caps and minimum premium.
Pass when all three are covered and any interpretation is recorded.

steps.title: Run the benchmark premiums through the rating engine
sop: Run the benchmark risk set through the configured rating engine.
Record the engine premium against the actuarial premium for each benchmark.
Calculate the difference for each benchmark.
Done when every benchmark has an engine and an actuarial premium recorded.
verify: Read the comparison table for the differences.
Pass when every benchmark sits within the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Resolve benchmark variances beyond tolerance
sop: Investigate each benchmark variance beyond tolerance.
Record the root cause as a table error, algorithm error or configuration error.
Apply the fix and re-run the affected benchmark.
Done when no benchmark variance beyond tolerance remains open.
verify: Re-run the full benchmark set after the fixes.
Pass when all benchmarks reconcile within tolerance.

steps.title: Log the configuration under change control
sop: Raise the configuration change record in the policy administration system change process.
Reference the rate plan version and attach the benchmark comparison evidence.
Record the environment and build the configuration was applied to.
Done when the change record cites the rate plan version and holds the evidence.
verify: Open the change record and check the version reference and attachments.
Pass when both are present.

steps.title: Agree the retest trigger for later rate changes
sop: Agree that any later rate table change re-runs the benchmark comparison.
Record the trigger and the owner of the retest in the change record.
Notify configuration and pricing of the trigger.
Done when the retest trigger and its owner are recorded.
verify: Read the change record for the retest trigger entry.
Pass when the trigger and its owner are documented.

generic.Defined scope/population: Base rates for every coverage part and loss cost relativities for every rating variable level.
generic.In-scope period: The developed and trended loss cost experience period used in the derivation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each relativity records its value, credibility weighting and complement of credibility.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Base rate times relativity set reproduces the loss cost total for the experience period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Base rate and relativity exhibits stored with derivation date and version in the modelling platform.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Relativity reversals across adjacent levels logged with an explanation or corrected.
generic.Test population: All base rates and all relativity levels in the rating plan.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a relativity reversal is unexplained or a relativity has no credibility basis.
generic.Exception handling path: Non-credible variables use the documented complement and route to the Product / Filing Actuary.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Base rates and relativities with credibility weighting and complement of credibility documented.
generic.Evidence location: Base rate and relativity exhibits in the actuarial modelling platform and Earnix.

steps.title: Derive the base rate for each coverage part
sop: Take developed and trended loss costs for each coverage part.
Add the agreed loading to derive the base rate.
Record the derivation in the modelling platform workbook.
Done when every coverage part has a derived base rate.
verify: Recalculate a sample base rate from loss cost and loading.
Pass when the recalculation matches the workbook value.

steps.title: Calculate loss cost relativities per variable level
sop: Calculate the loss cost relativity for each level of each rating variable.
State the credibility weighting applied to each relativity.
Record the relativity and weighting in the exhibit.
Done when every variable level has a relativity and a credibility weighting.
verify: Filter the relativity exhibit for levels with no weighting.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Document external sources and complements of credibility
sop: Identify variables where internal data is not credible.
Document the external or bureau source used as the complement.
Record the complement of credibility applied for each such variable.
Done when every non-credible variable names its complement and source.
verify: Read the complement entries against the non-credible variable list.
Pass when every non-credible variable names a documented complement.

steps.title: Check relativities for monotonicity and reasonableness
sop: Read the relativities across adjacent levels of each variable.
Flag reversals and values that are not reasonable against expectation.
Explain or correct each flagged relativity.
Done when every reversal is explained or corrected.
verify: Re-read the relativity sequence for each variable.
Pass when no reversal across adjacent levels is left unexplained.

steps.title: Reconcile the rate structure to the loss cost total
sop: Apply the base rates and relativities to the experience exposure distribution.
Compare the resulting total to the developed and trended loss cost total.
Explain any variance beyond the agreed tolerance.
Done when the structure reconciles to the loss cost total.
verify: Read the reconciliation totals and variance explanation.
Pass when the totals reconcile within the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Record base rates and relativities in the filing exhibit format
sop: Lay out the base rates and relativities in the exhibit format the filing requires.
Number the exhibits for citation in the actuarial memorandum.
Store the exhibits with the rate development documentation.
Done when base rates and relativities appear in numbered filing exhibits.
verify: Check the exhibit set against the base rate and relativity list.
Pass when every rate and relativity appears in a numbered exhibit.

generic.Defined scope/population: Minimum premium values for every coverage part and policy term the product offers.
generic.In-scope period: The expense and loss ratio basis current in the rate development being filed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each minimum premium records coverage part, term, value and the fixed expense it covers.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Minimum premium values in the rule manual match the actuarial minimum premium schedule.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Versioned minimum premium schedule dated in Earnix with the supporting expense basis.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Small-account quotes that breach the target loss ratio logged with the adjustment made.
generic.Test population: All minimum premium values and the sample of small-account quotes used to test them.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a rule manual value differs from the actuarial schedule or fails to cover fixed expense.
generic.Exception handling path: Values that cannot cover fixed expense route to the Product / Filing Actuary for re-setting.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Minimum premium set per coverage part and term with fixed expense coverage demonstrated.
generic.Evidence location: Minimum premium schedule in Earnix and the rule manual wording in the filing package.

steps.title: Set the minimum premium by coverage part and term
sop: Set a minimum premium value for each coverage part and each policy term offered.
Record the value in the minimum premium schedule in Earnix.
Show the fixed expense provision each value must cover.
Done when every coverage part and term combination has a minimum premium.
verify: Filter the schedule for combinations with no minimum premium.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Confirm the expense loadings match the base rate derivation
sop: Compare the expense loadings used in the minimum premium to those in the base rate derivation.
Correct any divergence so a single expense basis applies.
Record the confirmation in the schedule working paper.
Done when the two expense bases match.
verify: Compare the loading values in both derivations.
Pass when the expense loadings are identical.

steps.title: Test the minimum against small-account quotes
sop: Select a sample of small-account quotes across the coverage parts.
Apply the minimum premium and calculate the resulting loss ratio.
Adjust the minimum where the target loss ratio does not hold.
Done when the sample holds the target loss ratio under the minimum premium.
verify: Read the sample results against the target loss ratio.
Pass when the target holds on every sampled small account.

steps.title: Define short-rate and pro-rata treatment on cancellation
sop: Define how the minimum premium applies on mid-term cancellation.
State the short-rate and pro-rata treatment separately.
Record the treatment in the rule manual wording.
Done when both cancellation treatments are documented.
verify: Read the rule manual wording for both treatments.
Pass when short-rate and pro-rata treatment are both stated.

steps.title: Record the schedule in the rule manual wording
sop: Transfer the minimum premium values into the rule manual wording to be filed.
Check every value against the actuarial schedule as it is transferred.
Version the rule manual section with the schedule version referenced.
Done when the rule manual carries the schedule values at the correct version.
verify: Compare the rule manual values against the actuarial schedule value by value.
Pass when no rule manual value differs from the schedule.

steps.title: Store the schedule with its supporting basis
sop: Store the versioned minimum premium schedule in Earnix with the expense basis attached.
Link the schedule to the rate development documentation in the modelling platform.
Record the schedule date and version.
Done when the schedule is stored, dated and linked to its supporting basis.
verify: Open the stored schedule and follow the link to the supporting basis.
Pass when the schedule, version and basis are all retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: The sample risk profiles illustrated and every factor applied in their premium calculation.
generic.In-scope period: The rating algorithm version current at the time the illustrations are generated.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each illustration shows base rate, every applied factor and the resulting premium.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Illustrated premiums reconcile to independent hand calculations from the rating algorithm.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Versioned illustration set stored in SharePoint with the generation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Illustrated premiums differing from the hand calculation logged and corrected before certification.
generic.Test population: All sample profiles in the illustration set.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any illustrated premium differs from the independent hand calculation.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved differences route to the Pricing Actuary and hold the certification step.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Illustrations for each sample profile showing base rate and every applied factor.
generic.Evidence location: Illustration set in SharePoint and the generating run in the actuarial modelling platform.

steps.title: Select sample profiles spanning tiers, limits and deductibles
sop: Select the sample risk profiles so they span the tiers, limits and deductibles offered.
Record the selection basis in the illustration working paper.
Confirm the sample covers the extremes as well as typical risks.
Done when the sample spans the offered range and its basis is recorded.
verify: Compare the sample against the tier, limit and deductible option lists.
Pass when each option group is represented in the sample.

steps.title: Generate the premium calculation for each profile
sop: Run each profile through the actuarial modelling platform illustration routine.
Show the base rate, each factor applied and the resulting premium.
Save the output for each profile into the illustration set.
Done when every profile has a full calculation shown.
verify: Read each illustration for base rate, factors and premium.
Pass when all three elements appear on every illustration.

steps.title: Label guaranteed and non-guaranteed elements
sop: Mark each element of the illustration as guaranteed or non-guaranteed.
Use distinct labelling so the two cannot be confused.
Apply the labelling consistently across the whole set.
Done when every element on every illustration is labelled.
verify: Sample illustrations and check the element labelling.
Pass when guaranteed and non-guaranteed elements are distinctly labelled.

steps.title: Cross-check each premium against a hand calculation
sop: Hand calculate the premium for each profile from the rating algorithm.
Compare the hand calculation to the illustrated premium.
Log and resolve every difference before the set is versioned.
Done when every illustrated premium has been independently checked.
verify: Read the comparison table for outstanding differences.
Pass when no illustrated premium differs from the hand calculation.

steps.title: Version the illustration set in SharePoint
sop: Assemble the checked illustrations into a versioned set.
Stamp the set with the version number, generation date and algorithm version.
Store the set in the SharePoint product library.
Done when the versioned set is stored with its algorithm version stamped.
verify: Open the stored set and read the version stamps.
Pass when version, date and algorithm version are all recorded.

steps.title: Route the set for actuarial certification
sop: Send the versioned illustration set for actuarial certification.
State that no external use may occur before certification.
Record the routing date and the recipient.
Done when the set is routed for certification and the routing recorded.
verify: Check the routing record and the external use status.
Pass when the set is routed and no external use has occurred.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every rating variable considered, selected or rejected in the methodology.
generic.In-scope period: The data period used for modelling after exclusions and adjustments.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each selection records the rationale, estimation method and credibility standard applied.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Modelled data record counts reconcile to the validated dataset after stated exclusions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed methodology document with peer review date held in the actuarial modelling platform.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Variables rejected during selection logged with the reason for rejection.
generic.Test population: All rating variables considered and all methodology selections made.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any methodology selection is recorded without a written rationale.
generic.Exception handling path: Contested selections route to the second qualified actuary before the methodology is signed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Documented variable selection, estimation method, data period and credibility standard.
generic.Evidence location: Methodology document and peer review sign-off in the actuarial modelling platform.

steps.title: Document the variables selected and rejected
sop: List every rating variable considered for the plan.
Record the reason each variable was selected or rejected.
Keep rejected variables in the record rather than deleting them.
Done when every considered variable carries a selection decision and reason.
verify: Filter the variable list for decisions with no recorded reason.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: State the base rate and relativity estimation approach
sop: State the base rate derivation method used.
State the relativity estimation approach as univariate, GLM or bureau adopted.
Record why the chosen approach suits the data available.
Done when both methods are stated with a written justification.
verify: Read the methodology for the base rate and relativity method statements.
Pass when both are stated with justification.

steps.title: Record the data period, exclusions and adjustments
sop: Record the data period used for modelling.
List the exclusions applied and the reason for each.
List the adjustments made to the data before modelling.
Done when period, exclusions and adjustments are all recorded.
verify: Reconcile the modelled record count to the validated dataset after exclusions.
Pass when the counts reconcile to the stated exclusions.

steps.title: State the credibility standard and complements
sop: State the credibility standard applied to each variable.
State the complement of credibility used where full credibility is not reached.
Record both against each variable in the methodology.
Done when every variable names its credibility standard and complement.
verify: Filter the variable list for missing credibility standard or complement.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Obtain second actuary peer review and signature
sop: Send the methodology to a second qualified actuary for peer review.
Log each finding and close it before signature.
Obtain the peer reviewer signature and date on the methodology.
Done when a signed peer review is held with all findings closed.
verify: Read the peer review log and the signature block.
Pass when the methodology is signed and no finding is open.

steps.title: Release the methodology for use in filings
sop: Version the signed methodology and date it.
Store it in the actuarial modelling platform documentation set.
Notify the filing team that the methodology may be cited.
Done when the signed versioned methodology is released for citation.
verify: Open the released methodology record.
Pass when the released version is signed, dated and retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: One actuarial memorandum for each target state in the filing programme.
generic.In-scope period: The rate change history and experience period each state requires to be shown.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each memorandum covers scope, data, methodology, assumptions, indication and proposed change.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exhibit numbers cited in each memorandum match the exhibits in the filing package.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed memoranda stored in SharePoint with the state, version and signature date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing state-specific content logged and drafted before the memorandum is signed.
generic.Test population: All state memoranda and every exhibit cited within them.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a cited exhibit is missing from the package or a state lacks a signed memorandum.
generic.Exception handling path: State content gaps route to the Product Filing Specialist for the state requirement detail.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A signed memorandum for each target state with the state-required content sections.
generic.Evidence location: State memoranda in SharePoint attached to the SERFF filing package.

steps.title: Draft the memorandum core sections for each state
sop: Draft scope, data, methodology, assumptions, indication and proposed change for each state.
Base the content on the signed rating methodology and the indication workbook.
Save each state memorandum in the SharePoint filing folder.
Done when every target state has a drafted memorandum with all six sections.
verify: Check each memorandum against the six required sections.
Pass when no memorandum is missing a core section.

steps.title: Insert the state-specific required content
sop: Retrieve each state's memorandum content requirements from the filing reference set.
Insert rate change history, loss ratio standard and any prescribed exhibit.
Record the requirement source against each inserted section.
Done when every state memorandum holds its state-required content.
verify: Compare each memorandum against its state requirement list.
Pass when no state-required section is missing.

steps.title: Cross-reference cited exhibits to the filing package
sop: List every exhibit number cited in each memorandum.
Check each cited exhibit exists in the filing package for that state.
Correct citations or add missing exhibits before signature.
Done when every cited exhibit exists in the matching filing package.
verify: Run the citation list against the package contents per state.
Pass when no cited exhibit is missing from the package.

steps.title: State qualification and reliance
sop: Insert the actuary qualification statement into each memorandum.
State the reliance placed on data supplied by others and by whom.
Check the wording matches the professional standard required.
Done when every memorandum holds a qualification and reliance statement.
verify: Read each memorandum for the two statements.
Pass when both appear in every memorandum.

steps.title: Route the memoranda for peer review

Log findings against the state and the section affected.
Close every finding before signature is sought.

steps.title: Sign and attach the memoranda to the filing package
sop: Sign and date each state memorandum.
Attach it to the corresponding state filing package in SharePoint.
Record the version attached against each state.
Done when every state has a signed memorandum attached to its package.

Pass when every target state package holds a signed dated memorandum.

generic.Defined scope/population: The rate filing support package presented for Appointed Actuary certification.

steps.title: Assemble the rate filing support package
sop: Assemble the indication, exhibits, memorandum and peer review evidence into one package.
Produce a contents list naming each item and its version.
Freeze the package so the certified content is reproducible.
Done when the frozen package matches its contents list.
verify: Check each contents list item against the package attachments.
Pass when every listed item is present at the stated version.

steps.title: Confirm the peer review is signed and closed

Attach the peer review evidence to the package.
Hold certification where any finding remains open.
Done when the peer review is signed with zero open findings.
verify: Filter the peer review log for open findings.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Submit the package to the Appointed Actuary
sop: Send the frozen package to the Appointed Actuary for certification.
State the package version being submitted and the certification requested.
Record the submission date in the filing record.
Done when the package is submitted and the submission is recorded.
verify: Open the filing record submission entry.
Pass when it names the package version and the submission date.

steps.title: Obtain the signed certification
sop: Obtain the Appointed Actuary signature and date on the certification.

Done when a signed dated certification naming the version is held.
verify: Read the certification for signature, date and version reference.
Pass when all three are present.

steps.title: Record qualification, reliance and limitations
sop: Record the qualification statement given by the Appointed Actuary.
Record any reliance or limitation stated in the certification.
File these against the filing record for the affected states.
Done when qualification, reliance and limitations are recorded.
verify: Read the filing record entry for the three items.
Pass when all three are captured from the certification.

steps.title: File the certification and reference it in SERFF
sop: File the signed certification with the filing package in the repository.
Reference the certification in the SERFF submission supporting documentation.
Record the reference against each state filing.
Done when the certification is filed and referenced in every state submission.
verify: Open a sample of state submissions and check the certification reference.
Pass when each references the signed certification.

generic.Defined scope/population: The historical policy population re-rated under the proposed rating algorithm.
generic.In-scope period: The extract period agreed for the parallel test with the extract run date recorded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each policy record holds current premium, proposed premium and the change percentage.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Policy counts and premium in the test population reconcile to the source system.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Parallel test output and dislocation analysis stored in Earnix with the run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Premium changes beyond the outlier threshold logged with the investigated driver.
generic.Test population: Every policy in the extracted historical population.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an outlier premium change beyond threshold has no documented explanation.
generic.Exception handling path: Aggregate mismatches to the intended rate change route to the Product / Filing Actuary.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Current versus proposed premium for every test policy with dislocation distribution by band.
generic.Evidence location: Parallel test dataset in Earnix and the dislocation analysis in the modelling platform.

steps.title: Extract and reconcile the historical policy population
sop: Extract the historical policy population for the agreed parallel test period.
Reconcile policy counts and premium to the source system totals.
Record the extract criteria, run date and reconciliation result.
Done when the extract is reconciled and its criteria are recorded.
verify: Read the reconciliation for counts and premium against source.
Pass when both reconcile within the agreed tolerance.

steps.title: Re-rate every policy under the proposed algorithm
sop: Run the whole population through the proposed rating algorithm in Earnix.
Store both the current premium and the proposed premium on each record.
Check no record failed to rate.
Done when every policy holds a current and a proposed premium.
verify: Filter the population for records with a missing proposed premium.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Produce the dislocation analysis by band and variable
sop: Calculate the premium change percentage for each policy.
Distribute the population into premium change bands.
Break the distribution down by each rating variable.
Done when the dislocation distribution exists by band and by variable.
verify: Check the band counts sum to the total population.
Pass when the distribution reconciles to the full population.

steps.title: Investigate outlier premium changes
sop: Identify every policy with a premium change beyond the agreed outlier threshold.
Trace the driver for each outlier back to a factor or table change.
Record the driver against each outlier record.
Done when every outlier carries a documented driver.
verify: Filter the outlier list for records with no driver recorded.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Reconcile the aggregate change to the intended rate change
sop: Total the current and proposed premium across the population.
Compare the aggregate change to the intended overall rate change.

verify: Read the reconciliation and its explanation.
Pass when the aggregate and intended change reconcile or the gap is explained.

steps.title: Assemble the required exhibit set

verify: Check the exhibit set against the six required types.

Load the extract into the actuarial modelling platform.

steps.title: Reconcile exposure and loss totals to source
sop: Compare earned exposure totals to the policy system and incurred loss to the claims system.

Escalate variances beyond tolerance before proceeding.

verify: Read the reconciliation for both totals and their variances.

steps.title: Test for duplicates, negatives and out-of-period records
sop: Run tests for duplicate records, negative exposures and missing key fields.

Resolve every hit by correction or documented exclusion.

Pass when no duplicate, negative or out-of-period record remains.

steps.title: Identify and treat large and catastrophe losses
sop: Identify large losses and catastrophe losses in the dataset.

sop: Complete the data validation record covering extraction, reconciliation and quality tests.

sop: Lock the validated dataset and version it in the modelling platform.
Release it to the rate development workstream.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every approved coverage term and every clause of the drafted form set.

steps.title: Build the traceability matrix from the approved design
sop: List every approved coverage term from the design package as a matrix row.
