Store the matrix with the form draft in the document management repository.

steps.title: Map each coverage term to its form clause
sop: Walk each coverage term through the form text.
Record the clause reference where the term is given effect.
Mark terms with no clause as a gap.
Done when every term is mapped to a clause or marked as a gap.

Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Close every coverage term gap in the form
sop: List the coverage terms marked as gaps.

Update the matrix with the new clause reference.

Pass when the filter returns no rows.

sop: Compare the limits, sub-limits, deductibles and eligibility conditions in the form to the design table.

Done when every value in the form matches the approved design table.

sop: Read the form for provisions granting coverage or imposing conditions.

Pass when every form provision traces to the approved design.

sop: Complete the matrix with alignment status against every row.

Attach the signed matrix to the form draft version.

verify: Open the form draft record and locate the signed matrix.
Pass when the signed matrix is attached at the correct draft version.

Pass when every term of art has a recorded treatment.

Reject and return rewrites that change coverage meaning.

sop: Re-run the prescribed readability test on each revised consumer-facing form.
Compare the new score against the target for every filing state.
Return forms still below target for further revision.

verify: Read the score sheet against the state minimums.
Pass when no form is below a filing state minimum.

steps.title: Record the revision pairs for regulator justification
sop: Compile the before and after wording pairs into the revision record.
Attach the Legal confirmations and the re-run score sheet.
Version the record against the revised form version.

Check the load against the filing tracker disposed list.

sop: Retrieve the approval order or acknowledgement for each state.

sop: Reconcile the archive contents against the filing tracker disposed list.

generic.Defined scope/population: Forms, rate pages, rule manual, actuarial memorandum and exhibits for each jurisdiction.

generic.Evidence location: QA checklist in SharePoint and the SERFF filing attribute screens.

steps.title: Run the QA checklist over the package documents
sop: Open the QA checklist and work it item by item over the package.
Check form numbers, edition dates, page counts and exhibit numbering.
Record a pass or fail against each item.
Done when every checklist item has a recorded result.
verify: Filter the checklist for items with no result.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Verify rate pages against the approved rate plan
sop: Compare the rate pages in the package to the approved rate plan version.
Check every figure rather than sampling.
Raise a defect for each difference found.
Done when every rate figure has been compared.
verify: Re-run the figure comparison after any correction.
Pass when no rate figure in the package differs from the approved plan.

steps.title: Confirm the correct state variation is attached per state
sop: Check each state filing for the state variation form it should carry.
Confirm no filing carries the variation of a different state.
Correct any misattached variation before submission.
Done when every state filing carries its own variation.
verify: Cross-check the attached variations against the state list.
Pass when no state filing carries another state's variation.

steps.title: Check the SERFF filing attributes
sop: Check the SERFF filing description, type of insurance and sub-TOI codes.
Confirm they match the product being filed for each state.
Correct any mismatch in the SERFF entry.
Done when the filing attributes match the product for every state.
verify: Read the SERFF attribute screen against the product record.
Pass when description, TOI and sub-TOI match for every state.

steps.title: Log and retest QA defects
sop: Log each QA defect with the document, item and required correction.
Apply the correction and retest the affected checklist item.
Close the defect only when the retest passes.
Done when every QA defect is closed against a passing retest.
verify: Filter the defect log for open items.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Record the independent QA sign-off
sop: Confirm the QA reviewer is independent of the package author.
Record the sign-off with reviewer name, date and package version.
File the completed checklist in the SharePoint filing folder.
Done when the independent QA sign-off is recorded and filed.
verify: Read the sign-off for reviewer name, date and package version.
Pass when all three are recorded and the reviewer is independent.

generic.Defined scope/population: One SERFF filing entry for each target state in the filing programme.
generic.In-scope period: The submission window set by the launch plan and the state review lead times.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each entry records business type, TOI, sub-TOI, effective dates and rate change percentage.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: SERFF schedule attachments match the assembled package contents per state.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: SERFF tracking number captured per state and recorded in the filing tracker with date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unanswered state-specific questions logged and resolved before submission.
generic.Test population: All SERFF entries and their schedule tabs for the target states.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a required SERFF schedule tab has no attachment or a state has no submitted filing.
generic.Exception handling path: Entry blockers route to the Product Filing Specialist and are logged in the filing tracker.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A submitted SERFF filing for each target state with a tracking number assigned.
generic.Evidence location: SERFF filing records and the regulatory filing tracker entries.

steps.title: Create the SERFF filing for each target state
sop: Create a SERFF filing for each target state.
Select the correct business type, TOI and sub-TOI for the product.
Save the filing shell before attaching documents.
Done when a filing shell exists for every target state with correct coding.
verify: List the created filings against the target state list.
Pass when every target state has a filing with correct TOI coding.

steps.title: Complete the filing description and dates
sop: Complete the filing description and company tracking number fields.
Enter the proposed effective dates and the rate change percentage.
Check the effective date allows the state review period.
Done when all description and date fields are complete for every state.
verify: Filter the filings for blank description, tracking number or date fields.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Attach the schedules to the correct SERFF tabs
sop: Attach the state forms schedule, rate and rule schedule and supporting documentation.
Place each attachment on the SERFF tab the state expects.
Check the attachments match the assembled package for that state.
Done when every required schedule tab holds its attachment.
verify: Open each filing and check every required schedule tab.
Pass when no required tab is left without an attachment.

steps.title: Answer the state-specific filing questions
sop: Work through the state-specific filing questions in each SERFF entry.
Attach the state-required certifications alongside the answers.
Log any question that cannot be answered and resolve it before submission.
Done when every state question is answered and its certification attached.
verify: Filter each entry for unanswered questions or missing certifications.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Confirm the actuarial attachments for rate filings
sop: Confirm the memorandum, exhibits and certification are attached for each rate filing.
Check the attached versions match the certified package.
Raise a hold where an actuarial attachment is missing or superseded.
Done when every rate filing carries the certified actuarial attachments.
verify: Open each rate filing and check the actuarial attachments.
Pass when the certified versions are attached in every state.

steps.title: Submit and capture the tracking numbers
sop: Submit each state filing in SERFF.
Capture the SERFF tracking number returned for each state.
Record the tracking number and submission date in the filing tracker.
Done when every state filing is submitted with its tracking number recorded.
verify: Compare the tracker entries to the SERFF filing list.
Pass when every target state shows a submitted filing with a tracking number.

generic.Defined scope/population: The base policy form and every endorsement drafted from the approved coverage design.
generic.In-scope period: The drafting cycle for the approved coverage design version being implemented.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each drafted document records form number, edition date and the section structure.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Form index entry count matches the drafted base form and endorsement documents.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft form set stored with form numbers and edition dates in the document repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Broken internal cross-references logged and corrected before circulation for review.
generic.Test population: All sections of the base form and every drafted endorsement.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an internal cross-reference points to a clause that does not exist.
generic.Exception handling path: Wording questions route to Legal Counsel before the set is circulated for review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Complete base form and endorsements drafted with form numbers and edition dates in the index.
generic.Evidence location: Draft form set and form index in the document management repository.

steps.title: Draft the base policy form section by section
sop: Draft declarations, insuring agreements, exclusions, conditions and definitions in turn.
Follow the approved coverage design for the content of each section.
Save the draft in the document management repository.
Done when all five base form sections are drafted.
verify: Check the draft against the five required sections.
Pass when no base form section is missing.

steps.title: Draft each endorsement as standalone wording
sop: Draft each endorsement as its own document.
Name the base form and clause the endorsement amends.
Keep the endorsement wording free of restated base coverage.
Done when every endorsement is drafted as standalone amending wording.
verify: Read each endorsement for the named base form and clause.
Pass when every endorsement names what it amends.

steps.title: Assign form numbers and edition dates
sop: Assign form numbers using the company numbering convention.
Set the edition date on each document.
Record both in the form index.
Done when every drafted document has a number and edition date in the index.
verify: Compare the index entries to the drafted documents.
Pass when the counts match and no entry lacks a number or date.

steps.title: Check internal cross-references resolve
sop: List every internal cross-reference in the base form and endorsements.
Check each reference resolves to an existing clause.
Correct references broken by drafting or renumbering.
Done when every cross-reference resolves.
verify: Re-walk the cross-reference list against the draft.
Pass when no cross-reference points to a clause that does not exist.

steps.title: Check the draft against the approved coverage design
sop: Compare the drafted wording against the approved coverage design package.
Flag any coverage granted or removed that the design does not support.
Return flags to the Policy Forms Specialist for amendment.
Done when the draft reflects the approved design with no unsupported change.
verify: Re-compare the amended draft to the approved design.
Pass when every drafted provision traces to the approved design.

steps.title: Circulate the draft set to Legal and Compliance
sop: Version the complete draft form set in the repository.
Circulate it to Legal and Compliance for review with a return date.
Record the circulation date and recipients.
Done when the versioned set is circulated and the circulation recorded.
verify: Check the circulation record against the review recipients.
Pass when Legal and Compliance both received the versioned set.

generic.Defined scope/population: Certified form sets and approval orders for every state that has disposed its filing.
generic.In-scope period: The disposition dates recorded against the filings in SERFF.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each state record holds approval date, effective date and any stated condition.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Certified sets downloaded match the disposed filings listed in SERFF.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Certified sets and orders stored in OpenText with the download date and state recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Differences between submitted and certified forms logged and escalated to Legal.
generic.Test population: All disposed state filings and their certified form sets.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a certified set differs from the submitted version with no recorded regulator amendment.
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained discrepancies route to Legal Counsel before the forms are used.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Certified form set and approval order downloaded for every disposed state filing.
generic.Evidence location: SERFF disposition records and the certified sets held in OpenText Document Mgmt.

steps.title: List the disposed filings in SERFF
sop: Open SERFF and list the filings showing a disposition for this product.
Record the state, disposition type and disposition date for each.
Compare the list to the filing tracker.
Done when every disposed filing is listed with its disposition data.
verify: Compare the SERFF disposition list to the filing tracker.
Pass when the two lists agree on the disposed filings.

steps.title: Download the certified sets and approval orders
sop: Download the certified form set and the approval order for each disposed state.
Save each into the OpenText product folder for that state.
Record the download date against each state.
Done when every disposed state has its certified set and order downloaded.
verify: Compare the downloaded set count to the disposed filing count.
Pass when every disposed filing has both documents downloaded.

steps.title: Compare certified forms to the submitted forms
sop: Compare each certified form against the submitted version page by page.
Record any regulator-imposed amendment found.
Mark states where the certified and submitted forms are identical.
Done when every certified set has been compared to its submission.
verify: Read the comparison record per state.
Pass when every difference is recorded as a regulator amendment.

steps.title: Record approved effective dates and conditions
sop: Read each approval order for the approved effective date and any condition.
Record both against the state in the filing tracker.
Assign an owner for each condition stated.
Done when every state has its effective date and conditions recorded.
verify: Compare the tracker entries to the approval orders.
Pass when every recorded date and condition matches its order.

steps.title: Escalate unexplained discrepancies to Legal
sop: Escalate any difference between submitted and certified forms not covered by a recorded amendment.
Provide the state, form number and the nature of the difference.
Hold use of the affected form until Legal responds.
Done when every unexplained discrepancy is escalated and held.
verify: Check the escalation log against the comparison findings.
Pass when no unexplained discrepancy is left unescalated.

steps.title: Route the certified sets to archiving and configuration
sop: Route each certified set to the compliance archive for indexing.
Route the same set to configuration for form assignment.
Record both routings against the state entry.
Done when every certified set is routed to archiving and configuration.
verify: Read the routing record per state.
Pass when both routings are recorded for every certified set.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every consumer-facing form in the filing and every state it will be filed in.
generic.In-scope period: The form version submitted for readability testing before filing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each score record holds form number, state, prescribed test and the score achieved.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Score records exist for every consumer-facing form and filing state combination.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Score sheet or readability certification dated per state in the filing package.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Sentences pulling the score below standard listed for rewrite with an owner.
generic.Test population: All consumer-facing forms scored against every filing state standard.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a form is filed in a state where its score is below that state minimum.
generic.Exception handling path: Below-standard forms route to the Policy Forms Specialist for plain-language revision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Recorded readability score per consumer-facing form per filing state.
generic.Evidence location: Readability score sheet in the document repository and the state certifications in the filing.

steps.title: Identify the consumer-facing forms in scope
sop: List every form in the filing that is consumer-facing.
Record the form number and edition date for each.
Confirm the list with the Policy Forms Specialist.
Done when the confirmed consumer-facing form list is recorded.
verify: Compare the list against the full form index.
Pass when every consumer-facing form is included.

steps.title: Run the prescribed readability test per form
sop: Run the readability test prescribed by each filing state on every consumer-facing form.
Record the score achieved per form and per state.
Store the score records in the readability score sheet.
Done when every form has a score recorded for every filing state.
verify: Filter the score sheet for missing form and state combinations.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Compare each score to the state minimum
sop: Compare each score against the minimum readability standard for that state.
Mark each combination as meeting or missing the standard.
List the failing combinations for rewrite.
Done when every score carries a meets or misses result.
verify: Filter the score sheet for combinations below standard.
Pass when every below-standard combination is listed for rewrite.

steps.title: Identify the sentences pulling scores down
sop: For each failing form, identify the sentences and paragraphs lowering the score.
Record the clause reference and the readability issue for each.
Route the list to the plain-language revision step with an owner.
Done when every failing form has a rewrite list with an owner.
verify: Check the rewrite list against the failing form list.
Pass when every failing form has a rewrite list.

steps.title: Confirm type size, contrast and layout requirements
sop: Check type size, contrast and layout against each state requirement.
Record the check outcome per form and state alongside the score.
Raise findings for any presentation requirement missed.
Done when presentation requirements are checked for every form and state.
verify: Read the presentation check record per state.
Pass when every form and state combination has been checked.

steps.title: Attach the readability evidence to the filing package
sop: Produce the readability certification or score sheet each state requires.
Attach it to that state's filing package.
Record the attachment against the state filing record.
Done when every state package holds its readability evidence.
verify: Open each state package and check for the readability evidence.
Pass when every state requiring evidence has it attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every target state whose requirements differ from the base policy form.
generic.In-scope period: The state requirements matrix version current at the time of drafting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each variation records state, form number suffix, edition date and requirement addressed.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Variation count matches the states flagged as differing in the requirements matrix.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Versioned state variations with Compliance initials held in the document repository.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: States with unresolved requirement differences logged and blocked from filing.
generic.Test population: All target states and their mandatory provisions, prohibited wording and notice periods.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a target state with a differing requirement has no variation or amendatory endorsement.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved state requirements route to the Compliance Analyst before filing preparation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Mandatory provisions, prohibited wording and notice periods captured for every target state.
generic.Evidence location: State requirements matrix and variation form set in the document management repository.

steps.title: Build the state requirements matrix
sop: Build a matrix listing mandatory provisions, prohibited wording and notice periods per target state.
Cite the source rule reference for each entry.
Store the matrix in the document management repository.
Done when every target state has a completed matrix row.
verify: Compare the matrix rows to the target state list.
Pass when no target state is missing from the matrix.

steps.title: Flag states whose requirements differ from the base form
sop: Compare the base form against each state matrix row.
Flag the states where the base form does not meet the requirement.
Record the specific difference for each flagged state.
Done when every state is marked as compliant or flagged with its difference.
verify: Filter the matrix for states with no compliant or flagged marking.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Draft a variation or amendatory endorsement per flagged state
sop: Draft a state amendatory endorsement or state form edition for each flagged state.
Address every flagged requirement in the drafted variation.
Save each variation in the document management repository.
Done when every flagged state has a drafted variation.
verify: Compare the drafted variations to the flagged state list.
Pass when no flagged state is left without a variation.

steps.title: Number and date each state variation
sop: Give each variation its own form number suffix.
Set the edition date on each variation.
Record both in the form index against the state.
Done when every variation is distinguishable by number and edition date.
verify: Sort the variation index for duplicate or blank suffixes.
Pass when every variation has a unique suffix and an edition date.

steps.title: Confirm notice periods match state statutory minimums
sop: Read the cancellation and non-renewal notice periods in each variation.
Compare each against that state statutory minimum in the matrix.
Correct any period below the minimum.
Done when every variation meets its state notice minimums.
verify: Compare the notice periods to the matrix minimums.
Pass when no variation falls below a state minimum.

steps.title: Obtain the Compliance initial on each variation
sop: Review each variation against its matrix row.
Initial and date each variation that satisfies the row.
Return variations that do not satisfy the row for redrafting.
Done when every variation carries a dated Compliance initial.
verify: Check the variation set for initials and dates.
Pass when every variation is initialled before filing preparation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every rate, factor and table value on the filed rate pages and in the rating algorithm.
generic.In-scope period: The rate plan version and the rate page version being compared for the filing.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each comparison row records the value on the rate page, the algorithm value and the result.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rate tables on the filed pages reconcile one for one with tables in the algorithm.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed reconciliation naming the rate plan version and rate page version compared.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Differences found logged and resolved before the rate pages are attached to the filing.
generic.Test population: All rate values, factors, caps, rounding rules and minimum premium entries.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a rate table on the filed pages is absent from the rating algorithm or a value differs.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved differences route to the Pricing Actuary and hold the filing attachment.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Cell-level comparison of filed rate pages to the rating algorithm with sign-off.
generic.Evidence location: Reconciliation workbook in Earnix and the attached rate pages in SERFF.

steps.title: Extract the algorithm values and the filed rate page values
sop: Extract every rate, factor and table value from the rating algorithm in Earnix.
Extract the corresponding values from the filed rate pages.
Load both into the reconciliation workbook.
Done when both value sets are extracted into the workbook.
verify: Check the extract counts against the algorithm and rate page contents.
Pass when both extracts are complete.

steps.title: Compare the values cell by cell
sop: Compare each rate page value against the algorithm value cell by cell.
Mark each comparison as match or difference.
List every difference for resolution.
Done when every value has been compared and marked.
verify: Filter the comparison for unmarked cells.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Check order of operations, rounding, caps and minimum premium
sop: Compare the order of operations on the rate pages against the algorithm.
Check the rounding rules, caps and minimum premium treatment match.
Record any difference in the reconciliation.
Done when all four treatments have been compared.
verify: Read the four treatment comparisons in the reconciliation.
Pass when all four match between rate pages and algorithm.

steps.title: Check every rating variable has a table on both sides
sop: List the rating variables in the algorithm and the tables on the rate pages.
Match each variable to its table in both directions.
Raise a finding for any variable or table with no counterpart.
Done when every variable and table has a counterpart on both sides.
verify: Run the two-way match of variables to tables.
Pass when no rate table on the filed pages is absent from the algorithm.

steps.title: Resolve and document every difference found
sop: Investigate each difference and identify whether the page or the algorithm is wrong.
Apply the correction and re-run the affected comparison.
Document the difference and the resolution.
Done when no difference remains unresolved.
verify: Re-run the full comparison after corrections.
Pass when the comparison returns no differences.

steps.title: Record the reconciliation sign-off
sop: Review the completed reconciliation and the resolutions applied.
Sign the reconciliation naming the rate plan version and rate page version compared.
File the signed reconciliation with the filing package.
Done when the signed reconciliation naming both versions is filed.
verify: Read the sign-off for both version references and the date.
Pass when all three are present before the rate pages are attached.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every objection letter and information request received on the product filings.
generic.In-scope period: The response window running to the regulator stated due date for each objection.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each objection records SERFF tracking number, numbered points and the response due date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Response points submitted match the numbered points in the objection letter.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Submitted responses and attachments held in SERFF with the submission timestamp recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Objections needing an extension logged with the request date and the granted date.
generic.Test population: All open objection letters and their numbered points.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a response is submitted after the stated due date or omits a numbered point.
generic.Exception handling path: Rate objections route to the actuary and wording objections to Legal Counsel before responding.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A submitted response for every objection letter addressing each numbered point.
generic.Evidence location: SERFF response records and the regulatory filing tracker objection log.

steps.title: Log each objection against its SERFF tracking number
sop: Log each objection letter in the filing tracker against its SERFF tracking number.
Record the regulator stated response due date.
Assign the response owner for each objection.
Done when every objection is logged with due date and owner.
verify: Compare the objection log against the SERFF objection list.
Pass when every SERFF objection appears in the log with a due date.

steps.title: Break each objection into numbered points
sop: Break each objection letter into its numbered points.
Record each point as its own row in the response worksheet.
Assign a drafting owner per point.
Done when every objection point has its own row and owner.
verify: Compare the point rows to the objection letter contents.
Pass when every numbered point in the letter has a row.

steps.title: Obtain actuarial input on rate and assumption points
sop: Review every objection point touching rates or assumptions.
Draft the actuarial response and name the exhibit that supports it.
Record the actuarial input against the point row.
Done when every rate or assumption point has actuarial input recorded.
verify: Filter the rate and assumption points for missing actuarial input.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Obtain Legal input on form wording points
sop: Review every objection point touching form wording.
Agree the response position or the amended wording.
Record the Legal input against the point row.
Done when every wording point has Legal input recorded.
verify: Filter the wording points for missing Legal input.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Draft the response and attach the supporting documents
sop: Draft a specific response to each numbered point citing the exhibit or amended form.
Attach the amended forms, rate pages or new exhibits the response relies on.
Check every point in the letter is answered.
Done when the response answers every numbered point with its attachments.
verify: Compare the drafted response points to the objection points.
Pass when no numbered point is left unanswered.

steps.title: Submit the response in SERFF before the due date
sop: Submit the response through SERFF against the correct tracking number.
Capture the submission timestamp returned.
Record the timestamp in the filing tracker against the objection.
Done when the response is submitted and its timestamp recorded.
verify: Compare the submission timestamp to the regulator due date.
Pass when no response was submitted after its due date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every target state and the filing content being checked against its requirements.
generic.In-scope period: The pre-check run immediately before the filing is marked ready to submit.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each state result records filing type, lead time, required documents and exception status.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Pre-check results exist for every state in the filing programme.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Per-state pre-check evidence pack dated and attached to the filing record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every exception triaged as blocking or non-blocking with a recorded disposition.
generic.Test population: All target states and their mandatory provision and prohibited wording checks.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any blocking exception is open on a filing marked ready to submit.
generic.Exception handling path: Blocking exceptions route to the Compliance Analyst and hold the submission.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Per-state pre-check results recorded with each exception triaged and dispositioned.
generic.Evidence location: Pre-check evidence pack in SharePoint and the regulatory filing tracker.

steps.title: Run the compliance pre-check per state
sop: Run the pre-check for each state against the current mandatory provision matrix.
Check the filing content against the prohibited wording list for that state.
Record a result per check per state.
Done when every target state has a completed pre-check result.
verify: Compare the pre-check results to the target state list.
Pass when every target state has a recorded result.

steps.title: Check filing type, treatment and lead time per state
sop: Record the filing type and whether the state is prior approval or file and use.
Record the required lead time before the proposed effective date.
Flag states where the planned date does not allow the lead time.
Done when filing type, treatment and lead time are recorded for every state.
verify: Compare the planned effective dates against the recorded lead times.
Pass when no state has an effective date inside its required lead time.

steps.title: Verify state certifications, transmittals and readability evidence
sop: Check the required certifications, transmittal forms and readability evidence per state.
Mark each document present or missing.
Raise missing items as exceptions.
Done when every required document is marked present or raised as an exception.
verify: Filter the document check for missing items with no exception raised.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Triage every exception as blocking or non-blocking
sop: Triage each pre-check exception as blocking or non-blocking.
Assign an owner and due date to every blocking exception.
Record the rationale for each non-blocking classification.
Done when every exception is triaged with an owner where blocking.
verify: Filter the exception list for untriaged items.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Resolve every blocking exception before submission
sop: Work each blocking exception to closure with its owner.
Attach the evidence of the fix to the exception record.
Re-run the affected pre-check after the fix.
Done when no blocking exception remains open.
verify: Filter the exception list for open blocking items.
Pass when the filter returns no rows on a filing marked ready.

steps.title: Attach the pre-check evidence pack to the filing record
sop: Compile the per-state pre-check results into the evidence pack.
Date and version the pack.
Attach it to the filing record in the regulatory filing tracker.
Done when the dated evidence pack is attached to the filing record.
verify: Open the filing record and locate the evidence pack.
Pass when the pack is attached and covers every target state.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every target state filing scheduled for submission under the rollout plan.
generic.In-scope period: The submission sequence and dates set by the launch plan waves.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each submission records tracking number, submission date, reviewer and fee status.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Submitted filing count matches the target state count in the rollout plan.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: SERFF submission confirmations recorded in the filing tracker with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: States not submitted by the planned date logged with the reason and revised date.
generic.Test population: All target state filings in the rollout plan.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a target state is left without a submitted filing after the planned submission date.
generic.Exception handling path: Submission blockers route to the Product Filing Specialist and are escalated in the tracker.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every target state filing shows Submitted status with tracking number and submission date.
generic.Evidence location: SERFF submission records and the regulatory filing tracker.

steps.title: Confirm the submission sequence against the rollout plan
sop: Read the rollout plan for the state submission sequence and dates.
Order the SERFF submissions to match the plan.
Record the planned submission date per state in the tracker.
Done when every state has a planned submission date recorded.
verify: Compare the tracker dates against the rollout plan waves.
Pass when the sequence and dates match the plan.

steps.title: Confirm effective dates allow the statutory review period
sop: Check the proposed effective date on each submission.
Compare it against the state statutory review period.
Adjust the effective date where the review period is not allowed.
Done when every submission effective date allows the state review period.
verify: Recompute review period end dates against the effective dates.
Pass when no effective date falls inside the review period.

steps.title: Submit each state filing in SERFF
sop: Submit each state filing in SERFF in the planned sequence.
Confirm the submission is accepted by the portal.
Note any submission that fails and the reason.
Done when every planned state filing has been submitted or its failure logged.
verify: Compare the SERFF submitted list to the target state list.
Pass when every target state shows a submitted filing.

steps.title: Pay or confirm the state filing fee
sop: Identify the states that charge a filing fee or retention requirement.
Pay or confirm payment for each and record the reference.
Log states where a fee is outstanding.
Done when every fee-charging state has a recorded payment or logged exception.
verify: Filter the fee list for states with no payment reference.
Pass when the filter returns no rows or every gap is logged.

steps.title: Capture tracking numbers and assigned reviewers
sop: Capture the SERFF tracking number for each submitted filing.
Record the submission date and the assigned reviewer where disclosed.
Enter all three in the filing tracker.
Done when every submitted filing has its tracking data recorded.
verify: Filter the tracker for submitted filings with no tracking number.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Review record with attendance by workstream, performance against plan and root causes identified.

steps.title: Convene the post-launch review with every workstream
sop: Invite filing, actuarial, configuration, underwriting, operations and distribution.
Hold the review and record attendance by workstream.
Chase any workstream not represented.
Done when every workstream is represented and attendance recorded.
verify: Compare the attendance to the workstream list.
Pass when every workstream was represented.

steps.title: Review performance against the launch plan
sop: Compare approval timeline, go-live date, defect volume and early-life metrics against plan.
Reconcile the figures to the filing tracker and defect log.
Record the comparison in the review record.
Done when performance against plan is recorded for all four measures.
verify: Reconcile the review figures to the tracker and defect log.
Pass when the figures reconcile to source.

steps.title: Identify the root cause of each material slippage or defect
sop: Take each material slippage and defect and identify its root cause.
Record the root cause rather than the symptom.
Challenge causes that restate the symptom.
Done when every material item has a recorded root cause.
verify: Read the root causes against the material item list.
Pass when every material item has a cause distinct from its symptom.

steps.title: Capture each lesson with its evidence
sop: Capture each lesson learned with the evidence behind it.
State the proposed change to process or playbook for each.
Record them in the lessons log.
Done when every lesson has evidence and a proposed change.
verify: Filter the lessons log for entries with no evidence or proposed change.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Assign owners and due dates to every agreed action
sop: Assign an owner and a due date to every agreed action.
Log the actions in the issue tracker for follow-up.
Notify each owner of the action and date.
Done when every agreed action has an owner and a due date.
verify: Filter the action log for actions with no owner or due date.
Pass when the filter returns no rows.

steps.title: Publish the review record and track actions to closure
sop: Publish the review record with the performance, root causes and actions.
Track the actions to closure on the agreed cadence.
Record closure evidence against each action.
Done when the record is published and the actions are in tracking.
verify: Open the published record and the action tracking view.
Pass when every action appears in tracking with an owner.

generic.Defined scope/population: The handover pack, open items and ongoing ownership for the launched product.
generic.In-scope period: The transition window from launch stabilisation to the in-force team taking ownership.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: The handover records pack contents, open item owners, review cadence and escalation path.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open items transferred reconcile to the open defect and action lists at handover.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Written acceptance from the in-force team dated with the handover pack attached.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open items with no receiving owner logged and assigned before the project closes.
generic.Test population: All handover pack items and the open defect and action list.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any open launch item is transferred without a named receiving owner.
generic.Exception handling path: Unaccepted items route to the Insurance Product Dev Lead before project closure.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Written acceptance from the in-force team with the handover pack and open item list attached.
generic.Evidence location: Handover pack and acceptance record in SharePoint and the document repository.

steps.title: Assemble the handover pack
sop: Assemble the approved design, filed forms and rates by state and the guidelines.
Add the configuration record and the known issues list.
Store the pack in the SharePoint handover folder.
Done when the pack holds design, filings, guidelines, configuration and issues.
verify: Check the pack against the five required contents.
Pass when all five are present.

steps.title: Transfer the open defect and action list
sop: Transfer the open defect and action list to the in-force team.
Keep each item's owner and status intact through the transfer.
Assign a receiving owner where the current owner leaves the product.
Done when every open item is transferred with a named receiving owner.
verify: Compare the transferred list to the open items at handover.
Pass when no open item lacks a receiving owner.

steps.title: Brief the in-force team on monitoring and pricing watch points
sop: Brief the team on the monitoring metrics and their tolerances.
State the pricing assumptions to watch and the next rate review trigger.
Record the briefing content and date.
Done when the monitoring and pricing briefing is delivered and recorded.
verify: Read the briefing record for metrics, assumptions and the review trigger.
Pass when all three are covered.

steps.title: Confirm ownership, cadence and escalation in writing
sop: Confirm the ongoing product owner in writing.
Confirm the review cadence and the escalation path.
Record all three in the handover record.
Done when owner, cadence and escalation path are confirmed in writing.
verify: Read the handover record for the three confirmations.
Pass when all three are recorded in writing.

steps.title: Obtain written acceptance from the in-force team
sop: Send the handover pack and open item list for acceptance.
Obtain written acceptance from the in-force management team.
File the acceptance with the handover pack.
Done when a dated written acceptance is held.
verify: Read the acceptance for the date and the attached pack reference.
Pass when the acceptance is dated and references the pack.

steps.title: Close the launch project record
sop: Close the launch project record once acceptance is held.
Link the acceptance and the handover pack to the closure entry.
Notify the launch stakeholders of the closure.
Done when the project record is closed with the acceptance linked.
verify: Open the closed project record and follow the acceptance link.
Pass when the closure entry links the acceptance and handover pack.
